items.quote: It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
items.why: Quote states the key claim: input definition file rendered to SVG/PNG/PDF.

items.quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid.
items.why: Says it is a CLI, consistent with local use, but says nothing about auth, accounts, keys or license.
npm install command is consistent with a free npm package, but no mention of free, no signup, or Puppeteer.

items.quote: It's possible to call `mermaid-cli` via a Node.JS API.
items.why: Confirms a Node.js API exists, which is one part of the claim; does not address the no-REST, CLI-focus or breadth details.
Just a title fragment; says nothing about an MCP server, its vendor, or its URL.
